title: Normal save load restores one current follower presentation

verification.actor: The saved FOLLOWER Mankey (56), unchanged party identity, full current handle and native object.
verification.trigger: Load the copied unchanged test.sav through the normal shared boot. Do not teleport, replace party Pokemon, or explicitly spawn a follower.
verification.observable: Requirement shared.follower-direct-load.identity-v1: the saved follower has an attached current presentation at field readiness, and retains that exact source and engine identity for 16 complete game frames.

setupMutations.change: The common worker copies test.nds and test.sav. The originals and saved party stay unchanged. No prepared operations.
Install the shared read-only observer before boot. It retains complete game-frame snapshots and bounded native manager lookup receipts. Observation does not repair stale objects.

limits: Identity and attachment only; not normal spawning, input selection, motion, chain, smoothness or long-run proof.
A missing or detached saved follower at field readiness is the failure under test, not a reason to replace the subject. Boot errors unrelated to that observable remain setup failures.

events.value: Load the unchanged save and bind its saved follower at field readiness.
Retain 16 complete frames of that exact attached follower.

stop.condition: 16 observed frames, first identity failure, or the 120-second boot and run bound.

invariants: Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Normal load must not retain a stale object ahead of the current follower in native ID lookup
